newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index firms 0.63 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index firms 0.63 percent.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was up 0.53 points, or 0.63 percent, at 84.85 on Thursday after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index provisionally rose 11.99 points to 3,750.38.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market increased to 18.97 percent from 17.59 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
